messages:
mila: quick sync - planning announcement for next release. need canonical changelog + docs link + exact rollout timing for the post and webinar.
devon: target is 2026-05-03 17:00 UTC canary, 17:20 full. no infra conflicts.
kevin: webinar at 18:00 UTC. marketing wants docs link 30m prior so slides can be finalized.
mila: cool. paste the changelog we should pin in the announcement. one paragraph + bullets preferred.
devon: use below and keep exact phrasing: ```
RWD-Infer v2.5.0 (2026-05-03)
- Memory usage improvements for long-context models (-20% memory)
- New low-precision kernels for A10x and T4 (cost improvements)
- Improved KV cache eviction for multi-tenant workloads
- Stability and regression fixes
```
mila: thanks. rollback one-liner? marketing wants to emphasize our fast fallback.
devon: publish: "Fallback to rwd-infer-2.4.x with automated traffic cutover (<3 minutes)". ops will verify probes.
ops-oncall: will run canary probe at t+0 and t+3m and report in #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: created #deploy-1799876543-canary. posting hooks there.
integrations: for lead routing, please set webhook fields campaign=may03-release, source=register-page. SDR queue assignment: SDR-C. we'll post mapping to #integrations.
kevin: docs preview up at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/2-5-0. ashley will publish final permalink at 16:45 UTC.
ashley: confirmed, final permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rwd-infer-2.5.0
mila: great. marketing will use benchmark blurb: "20% memory reduction on long-context models". devon prefers wording: "up to 20% lower memory usage on our long-context benchmark."
mila: we'll use the up to phrasing. final checklist: 
- devon: confirm deploy timeframe (done)
- ashley: publish permalink (pending)
- integrations: webhook mapping (in progress)
- ops-oncall: run probes (pending)
- mila: finalize announcement copy at T-15m

kevin: preflight call at 16:30 UTC. i'll be on. devon: please stand by for immediate rollback if smoke fails.
mila: thanks team, will post final draft 15m prior for signoff. :sparkles:
